heading: What is your landlord’s address?
headingHint: Enter the landlord’s address written on your notice proposing a new rent or tenancy agreement

hints.landlordPostcode: Leave blank if the address does not have one

landlordAddressLine1.tooShort: Address line 1 must be 2 characters or more

landlordAddressLine2.tooShort: Address line 2 must be 2 characters or more

landlordPostTown.tooShort: Town or city must be 2 characters or more

landlordCounty.tooShort: County or region must be 2 characters or more

landlordCountry.tooShort: Country must be 2 characters or more

errors.landlordAddressLine1MaxLength: Address line 1 must be 100 characters or less
errors.landlordAddressLine2MaxLength: Address line 2 must be less than 100 characters or less
errors.landlordPostTownMaxLength: Town or city must be 100 characters or less
errors.landlordCountyMaxLength: County or region must be 100 characters or less
errors.landlordCountryMaxLength: Country must be 100 characters or less
